ios.desc:
Strongsplit is a precision workout tracker built for lifters who care about progression, not guesswork. Every feature is designed to help you train efficiently, manage fatigue, and make measurable strength gains, session after session.

OPTIMIZED WORKOUTS
• Unlimited workouts
• Create & save your favourite routines
• Create custom exercises to match your training style
• Optimized UI for rapid, low-friction workout logging
• Automatic set adjustments so your session adapts as you train
• Rest timers that keep you on pace
• Instant access to your previous set
• Pinned notes for cues, reminders, and intent
• Intelligent weight and rep suggestions
• %1RM tracking and percentage-based training
• Weekly muscle volume tracking to optimize stimulus and recovery
• Customisable auto progression
• Data export & imports
• Unhinged commentary

IOS FEATURES
• Live Activities to track workouts in real time
• Dynamic Island support so you never lose your session
• Apple Watch app with live heart rate and calorie tracking
• Full Apple Health sync
• Home & lock screen widgets
• Shortcut actions

ACTIVITY TRACKING
• Sync all activities from apps like Strava via Apple Health
• Custom training target thresholds
• Daily step tracking
• Total calories burned
• Workout duration and total distance

SET DIMENSIONS & INTENSIFIERS
• Weight, reps, rest, distance, and time
• Rep ranges, %1RM, RPE, and RIR
• Drop sets, supersets, pause reps, and negatives
• Failure sets, left/right sets, and warm-ups
• Automated actions that reduce manual input

HEALTH TRACKING
• Sleep quality tracking via Apple Watch, Whoop, Ultrahuman, and other Apple Health-connected wearables
• Recovery insights using HRV and resting heart rate
• Training readiness to guide intensity and volume
• Nutrition and calorie tracking
• Macro tracking for protein, fats, and carbohydrates

ANALYTICS
• Historical exercise charts
• %1RM bands and in-depth analysis
• Lifting trend insights
• Weekly best sets
• Exercise and routine analysis

quotes.text:
I know that the App Store is already saturated with numerous workout / gym trackers, but I feel that they all follow a similar structure, which leaves so much potential for speed, flexibility, and smarter training optimisation.

I built Strongsplit in hopes of creating a new workout system that feels more fluid, with metrics in the right places & format that can provide actionable insights.

Let me know if I've missed it completely, any feedback is much appreciated.
